cohort: The study included 1386 mothers with term singleton pregnancies (37-42 weeks) who delivered at district-level hospitals in eastern Nepal between July 2019 and July 2020.
finding: The hilly region was significantly associated with adverse sociodemographic factors, breech deliveries, and low birth weight, while lower/no ANC visits, early term gestation, and female sex were negatively associated with birth weight.
mod_finding: Breech deliveries were significantly attributed to the hilly region.
birth_weight: N/A (birth weight was an outcome measure, not an inclusion criterion)
